bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates non-integer years/compounds_per_year via int(), changing money calculations without validation
compound_interest allows negative principal and non-finite inputs, producing nonsensical balances
loan_payment silently truncates non-integer months via int(), changing repayment amount without validation
transfer is not atomic: account_from is debited before account_to.balance update, so invalid receiver balance or arithmetic failure can lose funds
transfer does not coerce/validate amount or account balances as finite Decimal values, enabling TypeError/NaN/Infinity contamination and inconsistent receipts
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min/fee_max/fee_pct exceed amount; fee_pct > 1 is not rejected
fx_convert uses assert for missing rates and does not validate positive finite FX rates, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity conversions
